lastCompletedStory.title: Fail-closed hard-precondition gate for the drain

nextStoryContext: US-003 is done. evaluateDrainPreconditions is exported from src/supervisor/drain-preconditions.ts. It is a pure function with no I/O: takes { workerIsolation: WorkerIsolation, containerPreflight: PreflightResult, planApproval: PlanApproval } and returns { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: 'container-not-active' | 'plan-approval-not-auto' }. Check ordering: container-not-active is evaluated first, plan-approval-not-auto second. The next story (US-004) wires the auto-dispatcher into the sidecar idle-tick and should call evaluateDrainPreconditions as the fail-closed gate before dispatching.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-003 touches only project-internal modules (drain-preconditions.ts imports from preflight-container.ts and models.ts). No external library API was exercised.
